submissions.findingTextShort: Purified mangiferin has direct human pharmacokinetic data, but the studied single doses are not an efficacy or consumer-dose regimen.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: PMID 26434292 studied single oral doses of purified mangiferin at 0.1 g, 0.3 g, and 0.9 g in 21 healthy men and provides direct human exposure/pharmacokinetic evidence. It does not establish clinical efficacy, chronic safety, cognitive benefit, exercise benefit, or a routine consumer dosing recommendation.
submissions.populationContext: 21 healthy adult men in a single-dose human pharmacokinetic study
submissions.usageContext: Purified mangiferin isolate exposure and pharmacokinetics
submissions.uncertaintyNote: Human PK establishes exposure, not therapeutic benefit or a validated maintenance dose.

submissions.findingTextShort: A 2020 positive cognition signal used branded Mangifera indica leaf extract, not purified mangiferin.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: PMID 32717999 was a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover study in 70 healthy young adults using 300 mg Zynamite, a Mangifera indica leaf extract standardized to more than 60% mangiferin. Positive acute attention, memory, and cognitive-demand signals are product-specific and cannot establish mangiferin-isolate efficacy. Nektium Pharma produced the extract and sponsored the study, so product and sponsor provenance must remain attached.
submissions.usageContext: 300 mg branded mango-leaf extract standardized to >60% mangiferin
submissions.uncertaintyNote: A multicomponent standardized extract is not equivalent to purified mangiferin, and sponsor/product provenance limits independent replication claims.

submissions.findingTextShort: A 2024 Zynamite trial was null on primary and major cognitive outcomes and reported more subtraction errors on extract.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: PMID 38665302 was a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover study in 114 healthy adults using 300 mg mango-leaf extract standardized to at least 60% mangiferin. The primary Accuracy-of-Attention outcome and other main cognitive and mood outcomes were not improved, while serial subtraction errors were higher with extract than placebo. This contradictory product-level result must remain first-class alongside favorable Zynamite studies.
submissions.usageContext: 300 mg standardized mango-leaf extract; product-level cognition outcomes
submissions.uncertaintyNote: The negative findings occurred among multiple analyses and should not be exaggerated, but they cannot be discarded when summarizing the product evidence base.

submissions.findingTextShort: A 2026 favorable replication remains evidence for branded Zynamite S, not proof that isolated mangiferin caused the effect.
submissions.findingTextNormalized: PMID 42515793 was a 2026 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover replication trial in 88 healthy young adults using a single 100 mg dose of Zynamite S. Reported processing-speed, attention/cognitive-flexibility, and mood benefits remain specific to the branded soluble mango-leaf extract. Multiple authors were Nektium employees and the study was company-funded, so the result cannot be normalized into purified-mangiferin efficacy or independent replication of the isolated molecule.
submissions.usageContext: Single 100 mg dose of branded soluble Mangifera indica leaf extract
submissions.uncertaintyNote: Product-specific replication improves evidence for that preparation but does not identify mangiferin alone as the causal active ingredient.
